intro: CAVA Sweet Tea (22 oz) brings classic Southern refreshment to the [full CAVA menu](/). Made with brewed black tea and pure cane sugar, this 200-calorie beverage delivers authentic sweet tea flavor in a generous serving. Available at $3.85, it perfectly complements CAVA Mediterranean dishes with its smooth, sweetened taste that balances bold flavors.
priceCalories: Priced at $3.85 for the 22 oz serving, CAVA Sweet Tea contains 200 calories. This drink offers zero protein and zero fat, with all 200 calories coming from 51 grams of carbohydrates. The straightforward pricing and calorie count make it easy to incorporate into your meal planning when browsing the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks).
whatMakesSpecial: What distinguishes CAVA Sweet Tea is its simple, authentic preparation using only brewed black tea and cane sugar. Unlike artificially sweetened alternatives, this beverage maintains traditional sweet tea character without complex additives. The 22 oz size provides ample refreshment for your meal, making it a standout choice among [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) options for tea enthusiasts.
nutritionFacts: Each 22 oz serving of CAVA Sweet Tea provides 200 calories with a straightforward macronutrient profile: 0g protein, 51g carbohydrates, and 0g fat. The carbohydrates come entirely from cane sugar, offering quick energy. For detailed nutritional comparisons with other menu items, explore the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to plan balanced meals.
whatsInside: CAVA Sweet Tea contains just two simple ingredients: brewed black tea and cane sugar. The black tea provides the beverage base with natural tea flavor and caffeine, while cane sugar adds classic Southern sweetness. This minimal ingredient list ensures clean, recognizable components without artificial sweeteners, preservatives, or flavor enhancers found in many commercial beverages.
tasteLike: CAVA Sweet Tea delivers authentic Southern sweet tea flavor with smooth, mellow black tea notes balanced by cane sugar sweetness. The taste is refreshingly sweet without being cloying, with the natural tannins from brewed black tea providing subtle complexity. It offers a clean, straightforward sweetness that refreshes the palate between bites of Mediterranean dishes.
customize: Sweet Tea comes as a complete beverage without customization options, ensuring consistent flavor in every order. However, you can adjust your overall meal balance by pairing it with lighter options from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) or adding protein-rich choices from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) to create a nutritionally balanced dining experience.
pairsWell: CAVA Sweet Tea pairs exceptionally well with spicy or savory menu items, as its sweetness balances bold Mediterranean flavors. It complements dishes from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) and [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas). The beverage also works wonderfully alongside rich dips and spreads, cutting through creamy textures with refreshing sweetness.
healthyChoice: At 200 calories and 51g of carbohydrates from cane sugar, Sweet Tea is an indulgent beverage choice rather than a low-calorie option. It contains no protein or fat, making it pure carbohydrate energy. Those monitoring sugar intake or following specific dietary plans should consider lighter alternatives. Check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for comprehensive dietary information.
howToOrder: Order CAVA Sweet Tea (22 oz) directly from the drinks section when building your meal in-store or online. Simply select it as your beverage choice for $3.85. The 22 oz size is ready to serve without customization. Find your nearest location through [CAVA Locations](/locations) to enjoy this refreshing drink with your Mediterranean meal today.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade (22 oz) at 360 calories, Sweet Tea offers a lower-calorie sweet beverage option at 200 calories for the same $3.85 price. Blueberry Lavender (22 oz) provides 190 calories, making it slightly lighter. Sweet Tea delivers traditional flavor without fruit infusions, appealing to those preferring classic tea over contemporary flavor combinations.
whoShouldTry: Sweet tea lovers seeking authentic Southern flavor will appreciate CAVA Sweet Tea. It suits diners who enjoy sweetened beverages with Mediterranean meals and those looking for familiar drink options. Anyone who appreciates simple, traditional tea preparation without artificial ingredients should try this beverage. It also works well for customers wanting caffeine with their meal.
worthTrying: CAVA Sweet Tea (22 oz) is worth trying if you enjoy classic sweet tea and want a familiar, refreshing beverage to complement Mediterranean flavors. At $3.85, it offers good value for a generous serving made with quality ingredients. While calorie-conscious diners might prefer lighter options, sweet tea enthusiasts will appreciate its authentic taste and simple preparation.
